title:
Manages the workflow for swapping an asset class, including data validation, fetching related data,
and triggering save operations.

This epic observes actions related to asset class swapping, evaluates the application state,
and determines whether additional sensor relations need to be reviewed. If review is required,
it fetches the necessary data and updates the UI accordingly. Otherwise, it proceeds to save the
new asset class and handles post-save actions, such as redirection and notification banners.
name: SwapAssetClassEpic
